title: Anitabi Index
description: Index of anime that anitabi.cn has confirmed pilgrimage (聖地巡禮) data for, keyed by Bangumi subject ID. Built primarily from api.anitabi.cn/bangumi (a single bulk endpoint that mirrors anitabi.cn's own map data). Falls back to enumerating api.anitabi.cn/bangumi/{id}/lite over a small embedded seed when the bulk endpoint is unavailable.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference. Always set to this schema's $id.

generatedAt.description: Unix epoch in milliseconds when this snapshot was produced.

source.description: Endpoint used to seed this build. Either 'https://api.anitabi.cn/bangumi' (primary) or 'fallback:lite-enumeration' (fallback path).

fallbackUsed.description: True when the primary /bangumi endpoint failed and the script fell back to enumerating /bangumi/{id}/lite over an embedded seed list. False on the happy path.

entries.description: All anime subjects with valid pilgrimage coordinates. Sorted by id ASC for stable diffs.

IndexEntry.description: One anime with confirmed anitabi pilgrimage coordinates.

id.description: Bangumi subject ID. The primary key shared with the Bangumi.tv ecosystem.

title.description: Original-language title (typically Japanese). May be empty when anitabi has no native title.

cn.description: Chinese localized title. May be empty when anitabi has no Chinese translation.

city.description: Primary city of the pilgrimage locations. May be empty.

cover.description: Cover image URL (anitabi-hosted). May be empty.

color.description: Theme color derived from the cover. Hex string with leading '#'. May be empty.

lat.description: Default-center latitude, rounded to 6 decimal places.

lng.description: Default-center longitude, rounded to 6 decimal places.

zoom.description: Default map zoom level, rounded to 1 decimal place.

pointsLength.description: Marker count. Accurate when sourced from /lite (fallback path); set to 1 as a placeholder when sourced from the /bangumi bulk list (which doesn't expose marker counts).

episodes.description: Episode count when known (parsed from anitabi 'ep' or '/lite'); null otherwise.

startYear.description: First-air year when known (parsed from 'info.放送开始' / 'release' / '/lite'); null otherwise.

modified.description: Upstream last-modified Unix epoch ms when known; null otherwise.
